title: New-store opening checklist

captions.instagram:
Opening another location? This is the checklist I'd want in hand: location, lease, buildout, team, inventory, layout and launch.

General guidance. Have a lawyer review any lease.

Save it for your next opening.

#SmallBusiness #Retail #Operations

Which step do stores forget most?
captions.facebook:
Every new location runs on the same checklist. I put it in one carousel: location, lease, buildout, people, product and launch.

#SmallBusiness #Retail

What would you add to the list?
captions.linkedin:
An opening is a project you'll repeat, so write the checklist once and improve it every time.

The checklist I'd use: location (who shops nearby, how they get there, who competes), lease (rent against expected traffic, term and exit), buildout (design, fixtures, timing), team (hired and trained to one standard), inventory (orders and a backup), layout and one launch message.

After opening: compare results with the plan and update the checklist.

General guidance, not legal advice.

#Retail #Operations

What's on your opening checklist that most people miss?
captions.x:
